messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging oncall — p99 latency spike detected for route /v1/generate (model=redwood-mini-int8, variant=calib-v2). Current p99=2.4s (SLO=1.2s). Auto-alert threshold crossed at 1790008762. Affected region: us-west-2.
carla-sre: on it. pulling dashboards now. anything visible in rollout logs?
ben-ml: i pushed calib-v2 to canary at 1790008600, small % initially. i'm seeing calibration jobs finish ~1790008580-1790008660.
frank-eng: confirming, we rolled calib-v2 from canary->gradual starting ~1790008620. no manual rollback yet.
alice-ops: adding context — streaming stalls count for the route jumped. looks like token emission pauses.
dan-cs: customers reporting partial responses and reconnects. cs ticket #INC-4827 shows 3 impacted customers reporting degraded UX.
eva-product: customers in orgs A/B/C on hosted plan — need impact window and list of affected API keys.
carla-sre: digging into tails. p95 ~ 750ms, p99 2.4s, p999 4.1s. not seeing CPU/GPU OOMs. GPU util normal.
carla-sre: logs show repeated dequant/decode warnings on the runtime: 
```
WARN runtime/quant.go: dequant-fallback: failed fastpath, falling back to software dequant (latency penalty) model=redwood-mini-int8 calib=calib-v2
WARN runtime/kvcache.go: kv-evict thrash; miss rate increased 18%
```
ben-ml: that matches suspicion — calib-v2 changed per-layer scales causing more dequant ops at runtime. if dequant falls back to software path we can hit tail-latency spikes.
frank-eng: can we toggle routing to fp16 variant temporarily? route config supports fallback to redwood-mini-fp16.
alice-ops: standing up a route override now (apply 100% traffic to fp16 for affected orgs). running command: 
```
$ redwood route set /v1/generate --model redwood-mini-fp16 --scope orgs:affected --reason "emergency tail mitigation"
```
alice-ops: applied. monitoring...
carla-sre: after reroute p99 dropped to 1.1s for the scoped orgs. overall p99 for global still 1.9s (some non-scoped traffic remains).
dan-cs: customers in ticket INC-4827 confirm responses resumed (though larger token cost). :thumbsup:
eva-product: note billing hit for those orgs — flag for postmortem.
ben-ml: i'm going to roll back calib-v2 for the model and re-run a controlled calibration. preparing rollback patch now.
frank-eng: @ben-ml please coordinate with ops before flipping server-side config; we need a graceful drain to avoid more stalls.
ben-ml: acknowledged. planned steps: 1) set model variant to calib-v1 sticky, 2) trigger rolling restart of inference pods with drain=60s, 3) watch p99 and stream stall metrics.
carla-sre: executing rollback plan. current state: set sticky->calib-v1 for model redwood-mini-int8, initiating drain on 30% batch now.
carla-sre: logs show calibration-service ack of rollback at 1790008984.
frank-eng: adding an emergency autoscale bump +1 pool for int8 dedicated to reduce queuing while drain happens.
alice-ops: autoscale applied, new pool online 1790009020.
carla-sre: p99 global now 1.05s, p95 480ms, streaming stalls reduced to baseline.
carla-sre: initiating handoff to night oncall @oncall-night. summary: root cause likely calibration profile (calib-v2) introduced more software dequant fallbacks and increased KV cache miss thrash leading to tail latency; mitigation = route override to fp16 + rollback to calib-v1 + temporary autoscale.
oncall-night: acknowledged, taking over. i'll keep monitor alerts quiet for now and will escalate if p99 crosses 1.4s again.
dan-cs: updated INC-4827 with mitigation steps, ETA for full resolution 15m. customers notified about degraded performance and rollback.
eva-product: coordinating billing notes and proactive comms. we should prepare a short comms explaining temporary increased token usage.
ben-ml: follow-ups: re-run calibration with stricter per-layer clipping, add unit/regression tests for dequant fastpath, and add telemetry to detect when runtime falls back to software dequant.
frank-eng: ops action: add a routing policy that prefers fp16 on tail-latency signals for 5m sliding windows.
carla-sre: creating postmortem ticket PM-2026-1790008765 and assigning action items.
oncall-night: i'll patch the incident channel with final status after quiet period.
incident-bot: Incident auto-notes: severity=sev2, duration=~12m (1790008762-1790009500 expected resolution window). pages=1, escalations=1, oncall_handoff=true.
carla-sre: quick note — observed a small regression in throughput for fp16 route (cost tradeoff). capture in postmortem.
eva-product: will schedule customer follow-up tomorrow.
frank-eng: recording timeline for postmortem: root event 1790008762 -> calib-v2 canary->gradual 1790008620 -> p99 spike 1790008762 -> route override 1790008870 -> rollback 1790008984 -> autoscale 1790009020 -> steady 1790009060.
carla-sre: thanks all. closing immediate page. feel free to add logs or any missed notes. :white_check_mark:
